title: Brevard County Commission, District 1
what_it_does: County commissioners set the county budget and property-tax (millage) rate, adopt land-use and zoning rules, and oversee county services such as roads, parks, libraries, fire/EMS and utilities.
verified_ballot_note: Republican primary result per ClickOrlando/Spotlight Brevard; November opponent not verified.

candidates.name: Micah Loyd
candidates.occupation: Canaveral Port Authority commissioner since 2016; state-certified general contractor
candidates.background: Won the four-way Republican primary (Pam Avery 26.06%, Stel Bailey 24.12%, Rick Heffelfinger 12.62%).
candidates.primary_result: First in Aug 18 GOP primary with 37.20% (4,732)

candidates.name: Aldon Bookhardt
candidates.background: Democratic candidate for Brevard County Commission District 1. His campaign is built on 'Rights, Resources, and Responsibility': taxpayers have a right to see county resources at work in their neighborhood, with commissioners holding department heads accountable for potholes, drainage ditches and easements, plus 'rights to clean water'. No positions on the guide's county issues were stated as of Sept. 18, 2026 (campaign site).
